children: RTX reaffirmed its 2026 outlook: sales of $97 billion to $97.5 billion, adjusted earnings of $7.65 to $7.75 per share, and free cash flow of $9 billion to $9.2 billion. Growth is expected in 2027.

RTX said PW1100 geared turbofan repair output rose 35% in Q3 and about 30% year to date. It expects aircraft-on-ground levels to decline in Q4 and keep falling in 2027.
RTX named rocket motors, propulsion, castings and microelectronics as supply-chain priorities. It identified three potential rocket motor suppliers and added 150 alternative suppliers for Raytheon.
